blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Lawmakers from the National Unity Party (NUP) on Wednesday called for modifications to the proposed spending plan for next year, urging the House of Representatives to fix their “serious concerns” that impede project execution and social aid distribution in their districts. Its members are concerned about “persistent reports of significant delays in the release of funds for infrastructure projects” financed by prior budgets, while criticizing what they felt as an “uneven and selective” approach by the Department of Public Works and Highways in approving construction works across districts nationwide. “In certain districts and provinces, projects that had been […]...
